{{small|15 August 2026}} |highest scoring={{nowrap|[[FK Arsenal Česká Lípa|Česká Lípa]] 2–5 [[MFK Karviná|Karviná]]}}
{{small|15 August 2026}} |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[2025–26 Czech National Football League|2025–26]] |nextseason= |updated=12 October 2026 }} The '''2026–27 [[Czech National Football League]]''' (known as the '''''Chance Národní Liga''''' for sponsorship reasons) is the 34th season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s second tier [[Association football|football]] league. The season will start on 25 July 2026.{{cite web |last=Novák|first=Miloslav|title=Příští sezona fotbalové ligy začne šest dnů po finále MS, bude opět s nadstavbou|url=https://www.idnes.cz/fotbal/prvni-liga/chance-liga-2026-2027-prvni-liga-terminova-listina-terminovka.A251203_131317_fotbal_min|work=[[iDNES.cz]]|language=cs|date=2025-12-03}} ==Format== The season format is unchanged from last season. Each team will play in the league format home and away matches. The top-ranked team will be promoted to the [[Czech First League]], the two teams positioned 2nd and 3rd will play off with the two teams from the first league positioned 14th and 15th in a home and away format. The two lowest-ranked teams will be relegated directly to the third tier. ==Team changes== Team changes for sporting reasons included [[FK Dukla Prague|Dukla Prague]] joining the league after being relegated from the previous season's First League, while last season's champions [[FC Zbrojovka Brno|Zbrojovka Brno]] changed places with them. [[AC Sparta Prague B|Sparta Prague B]] was relegated as the 16th-placed team of the [[2025–26 Czech National Football League|2025–26]] season. After the 2025–26 season, the clubs [[SK Dynamo České Budějovice|Dynamo České Budějovice]] and [[MFK Chrudim]] were administratively relegated to the [[Bohemian Football League]], after they failed to meet the conditions for obtaining a license for professional competition. Instead, [[FC Vysočina Jihlava|Vysočina Jihlava]] (15th team of the 2025–26 season) was spared from relegation and the winners of both Bohemian Football League (third tier) groups, [[SK Kladno|Kladno]] and [[FK Arsenal Česká Lípa|Arsenal Česká Lípa]], were promoted (instead of playing a play-off to determine only one promoted team).{{cite web |last=Daněk|first=Jan|title=Hotovo. Budějovice a Chrudim mizí ze druhé ligy. Svaz potvrdil, kdo týmy bez licence nahradí|url=https://www.sport.cz/clanek/fotbal-ceska-2-liga-potvrzeno-ceske-budejovice-a-chrudim-neziskaly-licenci-pro-druhou-fotbalovou-ligu-5474775|work=Sport.cz|language=cs|date=5 June 2026|access-date=8 June 2026|publisher=Borgis}} The last new team in the competition is [[FK Třinec|Třinec]] that won the [[Moravian-Silesian Football League]] (third tier). On 15 June 2026, [[MFK Karviná]] was administratively relegated to the Czech National Football League by the Ethics Committee of the [[Football Association of the Czech Republic]] due to alleged [[2026 Czech football match-fixing scandal|match-fixing]].{{cite news |last=Smrkovský|first=Lukáš|url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/eticka-komise-facr-vyloucila-karvinou-z-prvni-ligy-kvuli-ovlivnovani-zapasu-374612|title=Etická komise FAČR vyloučila Karvinou z první ligy kvůli ovlivňování zápasů|work=[[ČT24]]|date=15 June 2026|access-date=26 June 2026|publisher=[[Czech Television]]|language=cs|agency=[[Czech News Agency]]}} The club appealed the decision and the fixtures of the 2026–27 season were drawn with Karviná as a member of the Czech First League. On 28 June 2026, the club decided to withdraw its appeal and leave the league. Because the 2025–26 season was officially concluded on 22 June, the Karviná's place in the league was preferentially offered to the Czech National Football League's last season best teams. After [[FC Silon Táborsko]] rejected the offer, Karviná was replaced by [[SK Artis Brno]].{{cite web |title=Artis Brno přijal nabídku od LFA a v příští sezoně bude hrát první ligu|url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/sport-fotbal-artis-brno-prijal-nabidku-od-lfa-a-v-pristi-sezone-bude-hrat-prvni-ligu-310003|work=Seznam Zprávy|language=cs|date=4 July 2026|access-date=4
